n1.speaker: weda
n1.text: Can you hear that drip, love? The bathroom tap keeps dripping all night. It's driving me mad!

translations.fa: اون چکه را می‌شنوی عزیزم؟ شیر حموم تمام شب مدام چکه می‌کنه. داره دیوونه‌م می‌کنه!

branches.suggestion: Yes, I heard it last night too.
Let me have a look at it.

n2.speaker: weda
n2.text: And the hot tap won't turn off properly. I have to push really hard.

translations.fa: و شیر آب گرم درست بسته نمیشه. باید خیلی محکم فشار بدم.

branches.suggestion: It probably needs a new washer.
branches.suggestionFa: احتمالاً یه واشر جدید لازم داره.

branches.suggestion: Don't push too hard — you might break it.

n3.speaker: weda
n3.text: George used to do all these jobs. But his hands aren't what they were.

translations.fa: ویلیام قبلاً همهٔ این کارها را می‌کرد. ولی دستاش دیگه مثل قبل نیستن.

branches.suggestion: I'll ask Tom to buy a washer from the DIY shop.
branches.suggestionFa: به تام می‌گم از فروشگاه ابزار یه واشر بخره.

branches.suggestion: I can do it. I watched a video about it.
branches.suggestionFa: من می‌تونم انجامش بدم. یه ویدیو دربارهٔ اون دیدم.

cultureNote.en: DIY (do it yourself) means home repairs you do yourself. Big DIY shops are popular in Britain.

n4.speaker: weda
n4.text: Would you? You're a gem. Oh, and the bath plug keeps disappearing. I think Nicola takes it for her teddy's bath!

translations.fa: واقعاً؟ تو جواهری. آه، و درپوش وان مدام گم میشه. فکر کنم نیکولا برای حموم خرسش برمی‌داره!

branches.suggestion: Ha! I'll check her toy box.
branches.suggestionFa: ها! جعبهٔ اسباب‌بازیش را نگاه می‌کنم.

branches.suggestion: I'll buy a spare one, just in case.

n5.speaker: weda
n5.text: Clever thinking. Right — while you're the handyman, I'll make the tea. Fair's fair!

translations.fa: فکر هوشمندانه‌ایه. خب — تا تو تعمیرکاری، من چای درست می‌کنم. منصفانه‌ست!
